# Contributing

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CONTRIBUTING.vi.md)

Use small focused changes. Behavior changes require tests; evidence claims require the matching runtime artifact.

Before opening a pull request run `pytest -q`, compile verification, asset verification, notebook verification and the secret scan. Do not change FP16/offload policy silently and do not describe mock CI output as real Kaggle GPU evidence.

For documentation changes, keep English/Vietnamese pairs synchronized and preserve the language switch.
